# ENGINE-001 dependency and art ledger

Only runtime dependency: **SDL 3.2.10**, zlib license, upstream
https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL at immutable commit
`877399b2b2cf21e67554ed9046410f268ce1d1b2` (tag `release-3.2.10`).
CMake builds SDL statically. Its `LICENSE.txt` is installed into `licenses/SDL3.txt`.
The native HUD uses SDL_RenderDebugText and SDL's bundled debug font; it is not a
separate downloaded font. Keep SDL's license with redistributed binaries.
SDL is not vendored into this repository. Use the CMake source override described
in README.engine001.md for offline builds from a verified SDL source checkout.

All six 64x64 textures (wall, floor, ceiling, stone placeholder, signal, arch trim)
are original programmer art generated by `src/engine001/render.cpp`.
The generic stone marker is **not** Craglet's approved art or a new production
species. No owner sprite, private original sheet, third-party game texture,
external font, image decoder, game engine or network library is included.
Screenshots under `docs/bench/screenshots` are renderer output from this prototype.

Build tools: CMake >=3.24, C++20 compiler, Git; Ninja for presets. Python 3 is used
only for export checks, not by the executable. Local direct checks use GCC 14.2.0;
Windows CI selects VS 2022 v143 on windows-2022 and records the actual compiler
in telemetry. The runner image/toolchain patch version is not immutable; retain
the run's logs when comparing performance. A Windows toolchain baseline for
legacy OS support has **not** been certified. No Android dependencies are added.
